summary.zh: 为独立开发任务创建隔离的工作目录
summary.en: Create an isolated workspace for feature work

description.zh: 在开始新功能或执行实现计划前，单独准备一份工作树和分支，让改动与当前未提交的内容互不干扰。适合并行处理多个任务，或需要一段干净的起步环境时使用。项目需要是 git 仓库。
description.en: Sets up a separate worktree and branch before a feature starts, so in-progress changes never mix with your current checkout. Useful for parallel tasks or a clean start before executing a plan. The project must be a git repository.
